title: data-sets review round 1
description: Round 1 of the spec-review loop over the nine authored data-set pairs (#598, package complete at 0fd21462). Attended design session; the round's cold lenses dispatch as this session's own fan-outs per the ratified split. Composition and manifest in the plan comment. Round closes at full disposition with parity — the result comment cites child handles inline.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DISPATCH MANIFEST, round 1, 2026-07-21. Vehicle: attended session fan-out (design side of the split; consent under the session's permission flow). Composition: the phase-1c baseline — solution-architect (primary), solution-owner, documentation-reviewer — plus two set-validator lenses whose flagged scrutiny seeds this round: quality-engineer (gate data: the same-kind unanimity rule vs kind-migrating flakes) and ux (statusline: five-field glanceability at the adopted widths). Reviewer roles: read-only cold agents, fresh context, no shared conversation state, each reading its own domain prompt at entry. Inputs by content hash (sha256, first 12): registry artifacts — installed-artifact-manifest 4e7d071047bf, state-schema ba12c3f1a527, composition-scope-and-actions 300e6d0ff7f5, statusline-data 8e7453398123, gate-data dc573931b66f, dispatch-data 5465138b8e22, act-to-affordance-map 8284814660b7, economics-data 2a500761c58d, snapshot-schema 511af6c72e9b; mdatron schemas — 9f85e7bfa3ac, b80cfcc60d6f, 1d6bba518a23, e956db618fa7, af4f1b325552, 427c6b3ba2df, 0f6fc3e7bd2d, 1d66b7e354d4, 81550d54a99d. Model tier: the session model, inherited by fan-out. Effort: the session-level setting, recorded as such per the interim rule the dispatch-data set carries. Expected band: cold-spec-review-round, 3 to 15 findings (the seeded calibration band; this round is its first consumer). COVERAGE DECLARED — domains not dispatched and why: ai-engineer (its economics scrutiny note is conduct-informational, folded into solution-architect's brief; declined by round budget), security and privacy (no new trust or identity surface in prose data artifacts beyond the manifest's paths-only entries, reviewed at round 1 of the set; deferred with trigger: any finding touching identity-state entries summons them), platform-engineer, performance-engineer, data-engineer (authored these sets — author-side domain, its cold-reader is documentation-reviewer, pair separation at dispatch), accessibility, localization, technical-writer, red-team, and the remaining role domains (no matching surface this round; the statusline copy's assistive-technology read is a manual-class item on the operator's checklist per the Verification architecture). Findings return as structured lists and file as evidence-gated child issues with owner and validator; clean-round validity stated per lens.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ACTUALS AGAINST DECLARED BAND (the contract's in-cycle comparison): declared — cold-spec-review-round, 3 to 15 findings. Findings so far: 13 from the first two lenses (QE 5, UX 8), inside the band. Token actuals the band cannot express: QE 71,732, UX 50,948 (harness task telemetry); SA/SO/DR at 70.7k-111.9k mid-run (operator's monitor, 2026-07-21). Wall-clock: ~6 minutes per lens, parallel. Filed as the operator-observed finding child of this round; the band-dimension gap is itself round-1 evidence that the calibration loop works — the seeds were marked as seeds, and the first live consumer exposed the missing unit.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: MANIFEST CORRECTION (observed vs recorded): the round-1 manifest recorded 'Model tier: the session model, inherited by fan-out' — the transcripts show ALL FIVE lenses ran claude-opus-4-8 (39/56/62/22/47 api turns each, model field per request), NOT the session's model. The tier claim was assumed, not observed — precisely the class the provenance discipline forbids. Consequence for the dispatch-manifest schema (#669's manifest_fields): model_tier must be captured from telemetry after the run, never copied from session config at dispatch time. Corrected here; the schema note lands with the round-1 fix pass.

comments.author: xqjG

SEQUENCE: fix pass first, then #698's amendment text drafted against the fixed data, then round 2 dispatched via the Workflow surface with explicit model+effort dials and excerpt-read briefs (#674 conduct).
